shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations (§73), and a subsystem-health panel. Workshop 3776015553. WINDOW 9 PUBLISH PREPPED: tree STRIPPED (six moves), Release dll staged, notes in stash. User: run publish utility, paste notes, say done; then restore + smoke test.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH; the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.** 38 (§73): **WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, THERE MAY BE NO DRAW CALL THERE TO PATCH - own the draw: all three DynamicDrawPhases at the target loc, veto the atlas blit, key every phase off ACTUAL state (stagger durations are stat-scaled and advisory).**
